metadata.title: PLD Space uses Sttok for its investor portal, shareholder register and incentive plans
metadata.description: PLD Space uses Sttok to manage its incentive plans, its shareholder register, its general meetings and the relationship with its investors.
metadata.keywords: PLD Space, Sttok, investor portal, shareholder register, incentive plans, Sttok customers

summary.title: PLD Space manages its relationship with shareholders through Sttok's investor portal

quote.text: We use Sttok to manage our relationship with our shareholders and investors, along with its main features such as the shareholder register, general meetings, incentive plans and the board of directors.
quote.author: PLD Space

features.value: Investor portal, shareholder register, incentive plans, general meeting and e-signature

sections.title: About PLD Space
texts: PLD Space is a Spanish company that develops reusable rockets to put satellites into orbit. It is based in Elche (Alicante, Spain).
